_about: The knowledge graph's material chain (docs/NEWS_IMPACT_PLAN.md, phase 1): which products are made from which, by HS code, per industry, and the materials (species) news and supplier documents name. Hand-written from the sources below; every link cites one. data/eudr_products.json adds the official commodity → product links (EUDR Annex I). Loaded by seed_reference_data. reviewed: false until a person has checked the link.

Wooden furniture (office, kitchen, bedroom, other) and parts

links.quote: SAWNWOOD … Wood that has been produced from both domestic and imported roundwood, either by sawing lengthways or by a profile-chipping process and that exceeds 6 mm in thickness.
INDUSTRIAL ROUNDWOOD (WOOD IN THE ROUGH) … it is an aggregate comprising sawlogs and veneer logs; pulpwood, round and split; and other industrial roundwood.
PLYWOOD … A panel consisting of an assembly of veneer sheets bonded together with the direction of the grain in alternate plies generally at right angles.
It includes … core plywood or blockboard (plywood with a solid core (i.e. the central layer, generally thicker than the other plies) that consists of narrow boards, blocks or strips
WOOD CHIPS AND PARTICLES Wood that has been reduced to small pieces and is suitable for pulping, for particle board and/or fibreboard production, for use as a fuel, or for other purposes.

WOOD RESIDUES … It includes wood waste and scrap not useable as timber such as sawmill rejects, slabs, edgings and trimmings, veneer log cores, veneer rejects, sawdust, residues from carpentry and joinery production
WOOD RESIDUES … It includes wood waste and scrap not useable as timber such as sawmill rejects, slabs, edgings and trimmings, veneer log cores, veneer rejects, sawdust
WOOD RESIDUES INCLUDING WOOD FOR AGGLOMERATES … and wood residues that will be used for production of pellets and other agglomerated products.

PARTICLE BOARD, ORIENTED STRANDBOARD (OSB) AND SIMILAR BOARD A panel manufactured from small pieces of wood or other ligno-cellulosic materials (e.g. chips, flakes, splinters, strands, shreds, shives, etc.) bonded together
WOOD CHIPS AND PARTICLES Wood that has been reduced to small pieces and is suitable for pulping, for particle board and/or fibreboard production
WOOD PULP Fibrous material prepared from pulpwood, wood chips, particles or residues by mechanical and/or chemical process
WOOD PULP Fibrous material prepared from pulpwood, wood chips, particles or residues by mechanical and/or chemical process
WOOD PULP … for further manufacture into paper, paperboard, fibreboard or other cellulose products.

SAWNWOOD … It excludes sleepers, wooden flooring, mouldings (sawnwood continuously shaped along any of its edges or faces, like tongued, grooved, rebated, V-jointed, beaded, moulded, rounded or the like)
VENEER SHEETS … It includes wood used for the manufacture of laminated construction material, furniture, veneer containers, etc.

links.basis: Heading 9403 'Other furniture and parts thereof', subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture …'; solid-wood furniture is made from sawn wood (4407).
Subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture'; carcasses, cabinets and shelves are commonly plywood (4412).
Subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture'; flat-pack and cabinet furniture is commonly particle board (4410).
Subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture'; cabinet doors and carcasses are commonly MDF (4411).
Subheadings 9401.61 / 9401.69 'Other seats, with wooden frames'; frames are made from sawn wood (4407).
Subheading 9401.61 'Other seats, with wooden frames: Upholstered'; sofa frames are commonly plywood (4412).
Heading 4418 'Builders' joinery and carpentry of wood, including cellular wood panels, assembled flooring panels'; made from sawn wood (4407).
Heading 4418 includes assembled flooring panels and cellular wood panels, commonly with a plywood (4412) base.
